_about: Parameters of the model-based flipper controller (hardware_adapter/torque_control.py). See hardware_adapter/README.md.
_backend: closed_form (numpy only) or mujoco (needs `pip install mujoco` and the turtle_simulator repo; set model_path if turtle.xml is not at the default location)
_mode: pd_plus, desired_ff or computed_torque. Kp/Kd are in Nm/rad and Nm s/rad for pd_plus and desired_ff, in 1/s^2 and 1/s for computed_torque.
_gravity: Gravity in the shell frame of turtle.xml (x lateral, -y forward, z up). Change it if the rig holds the shoulder at an angle.
_kp_kd: Used when torque_control() is called with Kp=None / KD=None. Otherwise the gains passed in are used.

left._slots: Rows of the q / dq / tau vectors in torque_control() that belong to this flipper (motor IDs 1, 2, 3 in flipper_trajectory.py).
left._calibrate: offset_rad and sign are placeholders (the home positions of flipper_trajectory.py). Calibrate them as described in README.md before running in current mode.
left._quadratic_drag: Water only, closed_form backend: Nm s^2/rad^2 per joint. null uses the default fitted to MuJoCo's fluid model.

actuator._actuator: kt from the XW540-T260 datasheet stall point; armature is a rough estimate and friction is zero until identified with tools/fit_flipper_params.py.
